outcome: Maternal mortality (due to multiple organ failure, disseminated intravascular coagulopathy)
cohort: The study included twelve women who underwent re-laparotomy after obstetric surgeries at NRI Medical College & General Hospital (NRIGH), Chinnakani, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh.
finding: Re-laparotomy after obstetric surgeries is associated with high maternal morbidity and mortality, with haemorrhage being the most common indication and massive blood transfusion and maternal mortality being significant complications.
